messages:
olivia: Trying to bring up mistral-7b-v0.3 on staging, perplexity way worse than llama-2-7b baseline. quick heads-up, anyone seen rotary/vocab quirks with Mistral?
raj: Did you run the rotary conversion? Mistral's rotary implementation uses different inv_freq scaling vs default HF, can blow up early layers.
maria: We've hit this before with Gemma too — need rotary_scale and an adjusted inv_freq. example conversion command below.
```
python convert_rotary.py --src hf/mistral-7b-v0.3 --dst redwood/mistral-7b --rotary-base 10000 --inv-freq-scale 1.3
```
raj: Also check tokenization: some Qwen/Mistral builds use BOS id=1 while our baseline uses BOS id=2; if you don't remap embeddings you'll see a shift.
bench-bot: quick-run: raw perplexities on small eval set: mistral-7b-v0.3 (raw) 15.2, after rotary-fix 9.8, llama-2-7b baseline 8.7. latency: 39ms -> 42ms.
olivia: ran the conversion and applied vocab remap, quality improved but still seeing weird ngram patterns on code prompts (function args repeated).
nathan: code regressions often point to tokenizer merges. try forcing byte-level fallback or run vocab_aligner to fix offsets.
```
./tools/vocab_aligner --src-vocab hf/mistral-vocab.json --dst-vocab redwood-base-vocab.json --fix-offsets --output map.json
```
maria: we should add a small canary to eval-suite: 50 code snippets + perplexity + exact-match on function defs. make it a gating test for onboarding Mistral/Gemma variants.
olivia: pushed branch with conversion steps and flags to model-onboard repo: https://git.internal/redwood/model-onboard/pulls/128
deploy-bot: import completed for mistral-7b-v0.3-converted -> staging (gpu-pool-2). commit 5a9c
raj: next: quantization sweep. int8 vs nf4 — watch for hallucination/regression bumps.
bench-bot: scheduling quant sweep job q-224, will post results in this thread when done :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
olivia: agree — also let's standardize rotary params in model-metadata so conversions are deterministic (rotary_base, inv_freq_scale, rotary_scale flag).
maria: i'll add metadata fields: rotary_base, inv_freq_scale, vocab_offset, tokenizer_type + a small doc.
nathan: i'll prototype auto-detect script that inspects attention kernel sign/scale and suggests inv_freq_scale.
olivia: thanks all — keeping thread updated as quant sweep results land.
